args.sql:
SELECT c.region, SUM(o.amount) AS gross_revenue
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY gross_revenue DESC

transcript.text:
West region has the highest gross revenue among completed orders, matching the working definition of "primary region" (region with highest gross revenue from completed orders).
